description.en: The token to start the next query.

description.zh: SMC资源ID列表。SMC资源包括迁移源和迁移任务。列表最大长度 50
description.en: A list of SMC resource IDs. SMC resources include migration sources and migration tasks. The list can contain a maximum of 50 IDs.

description.zh:
SMC资源类型。取值范围：

- sourceserver：表示迁移源
- replicationjob：表示迁移任务
description.en:
The SMC resource type. Valid values:

- sourceserver: a migration source

- replicationjob: a migration task

description.zh:
SMC资源的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~64。N的取值范围：1~20。

Tag.N用于精确查找绑定了指定标签的SMC资源，由一个键值对组成。
- 标签键和标签值严格区分大小写。
- 仅指定Tag.N.Key时，则返回关联该标签键的所有资源。
- 仅指定Tag.N.Value时，则报错InvalidParameter.TagValue。
- 同时指定多个标签键值对时，仅同时满足所有标签键值对的SMC资源会被查找到。
description.en:
The tag key of the SMC resource. The tag key can be 1 to 64 characters in length. N indicates the serial number of the tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

Tag.N is a key-value pair that is used to filter SMC resources.

- Tag keys and tag values are case-sensitive.

- If you specify only Tag.N.Key, all resources that have this tag key are returned.

- If you specify only Tag.N.Value, an InvalidParameter.TagValue error is returned.

- If you specify multiple tags, only the SMC resources that have all these tags are returned.

description.zh: SMC资源的标签值。标签值长度的取值范围：1~64。N的取值范围：1~20。
description.en: The tag value of the SMC resource. The tag value can be 1 to 64 characters in length. N indicates the serial number of the tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc list-tag-resources --resource-type sourceserver --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --resource-id s-bp1e2fsl57knvuug0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun smc ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 's-bp1e2fsl57knvuug0000' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ResourceType sourceserver
